title: Anesthetics and cancer biology: Translational evidence from perioperative modulation to drug repurposing (Review).
snippet: Perioperative anesthesia is delivered during a brief but biologically dynamic interval in which surgical stress, inflammation, immune perturbation and tissue repair may alter the environment encountered by residual or disseminated tumor cells.
